faqs.question: Can you deliver to a boat or a ship?
faqs.answer: We can deliver to a marina office or a harbour master's address if they agree to accept parcels, but we cannot deliver to a vessel at sea or to a moving boat. Use the 'Delivery instructions' box at checkout to add the berth number.

faqs.question: Do you ship to Antarctica?
faqs.answer: Not at the moment. We currently ship to about 40 countries, and Antarctic research stations are not on the list. You can have the order sent to a friend or a forwarding agent in a supported country instead.

faqs.question: Can I get my order delivered to a PO box?
faqs.answer: Yes for standard delivery in most countries. Express and same-day delivery need a street address because the courier must collect a signature.

faqs.question: What if I am not home when the courier comes?
faqs.answer: The courier will try again the next business day and leave a card. After two failed attempts the parcel goes to a nearby pickup point for 7 days. You can also choose a safe place or a neighbour in the tracking page.

faqs.question: My dog ate my parcel. What can I do?
faqs.answer: We are sorry to hear that, and glad the dog is fine! If the courier marked the parcel as delivered, we cannot replace it, but you can contact support with a photo and we will see what we can do as a one-time courtesy.

faqs.question: Can I send a package directly to a friend as a surprise?
faqs.answer: Yes. Enter your friend's address as the shipping address and tick 'This is a gift'. The invoice and prices are left out, and you can add a handwritten-style gift message.

faqs.question: Will the parcel show what is inside?
faqs.answer: No. All parcels arrive in plain, unbranded packaging with only a return address, so the contents stay private.

faqs.question: Do you deliver on Sundays and public holidays?
faqs.answer: Sunday delivery is available in selected cities with express shipping. Public holidays are not delivery days, so those orders arrive on the next working day.

faqs.question: Can I collect my order from your warehouse myself?
faqs.answer: We do not have a collection point at the warehouse. You can pick up from a partner locker or pickup point by choosing 'Pickup point' at checkout.

faqs.question: What happens if a hurricane or a snowstorm delays my delivery?
faqs.answer: Severe weather can pause couriers for a few days. Your tracking page will show a weather delay, no extra action is needed, and the order will be delivered as soon as roads and flights reopen.

faqs.question: A parcel addressed to someone else arrived at my house. What should I do?
faqs.answer: Please do not open it. Write 'Return to sender' on it and hand it back to the courier, or contact us with the order number on the label and we will arrange a free collection.

faqs.question: What happens if the courier loses my package?
faqs.answer: If the courier loses your order we will send a replacement or a full refund, whichever you prefer. You do not have to wait for the courier's investigation to finish.

faqs.question: I lost my tracking number. How do I find it?
faqs.answer: Sign in and open 'My Orders'. The tracking number is shown on each shipped order, and it was also sent in your shipping confirmation email. Guest customers can look it up with their order number and email address.

faqs.question: I checked out as a guest. How can I follow my parcel?
faqs.answer: No account is needed. Use the 'Guest lookup' link in the page footer and enter the reference from your confirmation email together with the email address you used at checkout.

faqs.question: My name is spelled wrong on the order. Can you fix it?
faqs.answer: Yes, as long as the order has not shipped. Contact support with your order number and the correct spelling, and we will update it before dispatch.

faqs.question: The item I ordered was discontinued. What happens now?
faqs.answer: If we cannot fulfil an item after you order it, we will email you within one business day with a similar alternative or a full refund. You are never charged for an item we cannot send.

faqs.question: Can I order by phone or by WhatsApp?
faqs.answer: Phone orders are accepted on 1-800-555-0199 during support hours. We do not take orders through WhatsApp or social media messages for security reasons.

faqs.question: Can I return something I have already used or worn?
faqs.answer: Used items cannot be returned for a change of mind. If it is faulty, damaged or not as described, you can return it at any time within the warranty period regardless of use.

faqs.question: Can I return a gift without a receipt?
faqs.answer: Yes. The giver's name and price are never shown. Ask for a gift return in your account or contact support with the order number, and you will receive store credit instead of a cash refund.

faqs.question: Can I return an item that I bought on sale?
faqs.answer: Yes, sale items follow the same 30-day return policy. Items marked 'Final sale' are the only exception and cannot be returned.

faqs.question: Do you take back old products for recycling?
faqs.answer: Yes. Request a free recycling label from the 'Returns' page. We recycle old electronics and packaging, and you receive a 10% voucher for your next order.

faqs.question: Can I pay with Bitcoin or other cryptocurrency?
faqs.answer: Not at the moment. We only accept cards, PayPal, Apple Pay, Google Pay and gift cards.

faqs.question: Do you offer cash on delivery?
faqs.answer: No, we do not offer cash on delivery. All orders are paid online at checkout.

faqs.question: Why is the price in my cart different from the product page?
faqs.answer: Prices can change when you select a size or color, when a sale ends, or when your delivery country adds taxes. The cart always shows the final price before you pay.

faqs.question: Do you price match if I find it cheaper elsewhere?
faqs.answer: Yes. If an identical item is in stock at a lower price from another authorised retailer, contact support within 14 days of buying with a link and we will refund the difference.

faqs.question: Can I get an invoice with my company name and VAT number?
faqs.answer: Yes. Add your company details at checkout or in 'Account settings' > 'Billing', and download the invoice from 'My Orders' once the order ships.

faqs.question: Can I pay in a different currency?
faqs.answer: Prices can be shown in several currencies using the selector at the top of the page. Your bank may add a small conversion fee, which we do not control.

faqs.question: Do gift cards expire?
faqs.answer: No. Our gift cards never expire and carry no fees.

faqs.question: Can I use a gift card to buy another gift card?
faqs.answer: No, gift cards cannot be used to purchase other gift cards. They can be used for any regular product and for shipping.

faqs.question: Can I use a nickname instead of my real name on my account?
faqs.answer: You can set a display name in 'Account settings' > 'Profile'. Your legal name is only required for payments and deliveries.

faqs.question: Do you sell my personal data to other companies?
faqs.answer: No. We never sell personal data. We only share what is needed with payment processors and couriers to complete your order.

faqs.question: Can I get a copy of all the data you have about me?
faqs.answer: Yes. Go to 'Account settings' > 'Privacy' > 'Download my data' and we will email you a file within 7 days.

faqs.question: Do you give a birthday discount?
faqs.answer: Yes. Add your birthday under 'Account settings' > 'Profile' and we will email you a 15% voucher in your birthday week.

faqs.question: Do you sell used or refurbished products?
faqs.answer: Some electronics are sold as certified refurbished, clearly labelled on the product page, with a 12-month warranty. Everything else is new.

faqs.question: Is your packaging eco-friendly?
faqs.answer: Yes. Our boxes and paper fillers are made from recycled cardboard, and we have stopped using plastic bubble wrap.

faqs.question: Can I ask you to stock a product you do not sell?
faqs.answer: Absolutely. Send your suggestion to support or use the 'Request a product' form on the Help page. We review requests every month.

faqs.question: Can I get my item engraved or personalised?
faqs.answer: Engraving is available on selected products and is chosen on the product page before you add it to the basket. Personalised items cannot be returned unless faulty.

faqs.question: Do you offer plus sizes or inclusive sizing?
faqs.answer: Many items are available in extended sizes. Use the 'Size range' filter on any category page to show only the sizes you need.

faqs.question: Do you give free samples?
faqs.answer: Free samples are included with selected orders, but we cannot send samples on request.

faqs.question: Am I talking to a robot right now?
faqs.answer: You are chatting with an automated FAQ bot that finds the closest answer to your question. If it cannot help, ask for a human agent and our team will take over.

faqs.question: Can I speak to a manager?
faqs.answer: Yes. Ask the agent to escalate your case or email support@shopease.example with the subject 'Escalation'. A manager replies within one business day.

faqs.question: Will you delete a bad review I leave?
faqs.answer: No. We do not remove reviews because they are negative. We only remove reviews that contain offensive language, personal information or spam.

faqs.question: Do you have a mobile app?
faqs.answer: Yes. The ShopEase app is available for iOS and Android with order tracking, push notifications and app-only offers.

faqs.question: Can I visit your warehouse or office?
faqs.answer: Our warehouse and office are not open to visitors for safety and security reasons. You can meet our team at our pop-up stores.

faqs.question: How do I track my order?
faqs.answer: Open 'My Orders' in your account and click 'Track package'. You will also find a tracking link in your shipping confirmation email, which is sent within 24 hours of dispatch.

faqs.question: How can I cancel my order?
faqs.answer: You can cancel for free from 'My Orders' as long as the order has not shipped yet. Once it has shipped, please refuse delivery or start a return after it arrives.

faqs.question: Can I change my shipping address after placing an order?
faqs.answer: Yes, but only before the order is dispatched. Go to 'My Orders' > 'Edit address' or contact support right away. We cannot redirect a parcel that is already in transit.

faqs.question: I received a damaged or incorrect item. What should I do?
faqs.answer: We are sorry about that! Send us a photo of the item and your order number via the 'Report a problem' button within 7 days of delivery. We will ship a replacement or issue a full refund.

faqs.question: Why is my order delayed?
faqs.answer: Delays can be caused by high demand, bad weather or customs checks. Check the live tracking page for updates. If your order is more than 3 business days late, contact support and we will investigate.

faqs.question: How long does delivery take?
faqs.answer: Standard delivery takes 3-5 business days. Express delivery takes 1-2 business days. Remote areas may take up to 2 extra days.

faqs.question: How much does shipping cost?
faqs.answer: Standard shipping costs $4.99, and it is free on orders over $50. Express shipping costs $12.99.

faqs.question: Do you ship internationally?
faqs.answer: Yes, we ship to over 40 countries. International delivery takes 7-14 business days, and import duties or taxes may be charged by your local customs office.

faqs.question: Do you offer same-day or express delivery?
faqs.answer: Express delivery (1-2 business days) is available at checkout for most addresses. Same-day delivery is currently available in selected cities for orders placed before 12:00 noon.

faqs.question: What is your return policy?
faqs.answer: You can return most items within 30 days of delivery for a full refund, provided they are unused, unwashed and in their original packaging with tags attached.

faqs.question: How do I return an item?
faqs.answer: Go to 'My Orders', choose the item and click 'Return'. Print the prepaid label, pack the item securely and drop it at any partner courier location.

faqs.question: When will I get my refund?
faqs.answer: Refunds are issued to your original payment method within 5-7 business days after we receive and inspect your return. Your bank may need additional time to post it.

faqs.question: Can I exchange an item for a different size or color?
faqs.answer: Yes. Start a return and select 'Exchange' to choose another size or color. If the new item costs more, you will only pay the difference.

faqs.question: Which payment methods do you accept?
faqs.answer: We accept Visa, Mastercard, American Express, PayPal, Apple Pay, Google Pay and gift cards.

faqs.question: Is it safe to use my credit card on your website?
faqs.answer: Yes. All payments are encrypted with SSL/TLS and processed by PCI-DSS compliant providers. We never store your full card number on our servers.

faqs.question: My payment failed. What should I do?
faqs.answer: Please check your card details, billing address and available balance. If the problem continues, try another payment method or contact your bank, as they may have blocked the transaction.

faqs.question: How do I use a discount code or promo code?
faqs.answer: Enter your code in the 'Promo code' box on the checkout page and click 'Apply'. Only one code can be used per order, and some items may be excluded.

faqs.question: Can I pay in installments?
faqs.answer: Yes. Choose 'Pay in 4' at checkout to split your purchase into four interest-free payments, available for orders between $50 and $1,000.

faqs.question: How do I create an account?
faqs.answer: Click 'Sign up' at the top right of the page, enter your name, email and a password, then confirm your email address using the link we send you.

faqs.question: I forgot my password. How can I reset it?
faqs.answer: Click 'Log in' > 'Forgot password' and enter your email. We will send you a reset link that stays valid for 30 minutes.

faqs.question: How do I update my email address or phone number?
faqs.answer: Sign in and go to 'Account settings' > 'Profile'. Edit your email or phone number and click 'Save'. You will need to verify a new email address.

faqs.question: How do I delete my account?
faqs.answer: Go to 'Account settings' > 'Privacy' > 'Delete account'. Your personal data will be erased within 30 days. Order records required by law may be retained.

faqs.question: How do I unsubscribe from marketing emails?
faqs.answer: Click the 'Unsubscribe' link at the bottom of any promotional email, or turn off 'Marketing emails' under 'Account settings' > 'Notifications'.

faqs.question: How do I know if a product is in stock?
faqs.answer: The product page shows 'In stock' or 'Out of stock'. For sold-out items click 'Notify me' and we will email you as soon as it is back.

faqs.question: Do your products come with a warranty?
faqs.answer: Electronics come with a 12-month manufacturer warranty. Other products are covered against defects for 90 days. Keep your order confirmation as proof of purchase.

faqs.question: How do I find the right size?
faqs.answer: Each product page has a 'Size guide' link with measurements in cm and inches. If you are between sizes, we recommend sizing up.

faqs.question: How can I contact customer support?
faqs.answer: You can chat with us live from the bottom right of the page, email support@shopease.example, or call 1-800-555-0199.

faqs.question: What are your customer support hours?
faqs.answer: Our team is available Monday to Friday, 9:00 to 18:00 (local time), and Saturday 10:00 to 16:00. Email is monitored 24/7 with replies within one business day.

faqs.question: Do you have a physical store I can visit?
faqs.answer: We are an online-only retailer, but we run pop-up stores in selected cities. Check the 'Events' page for upcoming locations.

faqs.question: Do you sell gift cards and how do I redeem them?
faqs.answer: Digital gift cards from $10 to $500 are available on the 'Gift cards' page. To redeem one, enter the code in the 'Gift card' box at checkout.

faqs.question: Where can I find coupon codes and current offers?
faqs.answer: All current offers and coupon codes are listed in the 'Offers' banner on the home page. Subscribe to our newsletter to get exclusive codes by email, then enter the code at checkout.

faqs.question: Do you offer a discount on my first order?
faqs.answer: Yes. New customers get 10% off their first order with the code WELCOME10, valid for 30 days after signing up.

faqs.question: Do you have a sale or clearance section?
faqs.answer: Yes. Open 'Sale' in the main menu to see reduced items. Clearance stock is marked 'Final sale' and cannot be returned.

faqs.question: Do you have a loyalty or rewards program?
faqs.answer: Yes. Join ShopEase Rewards for free in 'Account settings' and earn 1 point per $1 spent. 100 points give you a $5 voucher.
